register.labelZh: CLOCK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: clock in 和 clock on 表示某人開始上班；clock off 和 clock out 則表示某人結束工作。；clock in at 可以用來報告跑手的完成時間，也可以說明電影、歌曲、演講或節目的長度。；clock something up 可以描述累積行駛的里數、完成的小時、取得的分數和其他總數。；這些表達常見於工作紀錄、運動、旅程報告和媒體討論。
register.summaryEn: Clock in and clock on show that a person has started work. Clock off and clock out show that the person has finished. Clock in at can report a runner’s finishing time or the length of a film, song, speech or programme. Clock something up can describe kilometres travelled, hours completed, points earned and other growing totals. These expressions commonly appear in workplace records, sport, travel reports and media discussions.
